apiSequence: IDWriteTextAnalyzer::GetGlyphs(text, len, face, isSideways=0, isRTL=0, scriptAnalysis={0,DEFAULT}, "en-us", typography=NULL, features=NULL, featureRanges=0, maxGlyphCount, clusterMap, textProps, glyphIndices, glyphProps, &actualGlyphCount)
IDWriteTextAnalyzer::GetGlyphPlacements(text, clusterMap, textProps, len, glyphIndices, glyphProps, glyphCount, face, 0, 0, {0,DEFAULT}, "en-us", NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, glyphAdvances, glyphOffsets)
scriptAnalysis: DWRITE_SCRIPT_ANALYSIS { script = 0, shapes = DWRITE_SCRIPT_SHAPES_DEFAULT } for every case; locale "en-us"; no DWRITE_TYPOGRAPHIC_FEATURES array, so the font's default features apply (kern/liga/clig on, matching HarfBuzz defaults).
units: advancesDip/offsetsDip are DIPs (= px at 96 dpi) as returned by GetGlyphPlacements at the requested emSize. totalAdvanceDesignUnits is the same total scaled by upem/emSize, i.e. the HarfBuzz-comparable number.
lineHeightNote: lineHeightDip is DERIVED from IDWriteFontFace::GetMetrics as (ascent+descent+lineGap)*emSize/upem. It is not read from an IDWriteTextLayout, because a layout needs an IDWriteTextFormat, which needs the font to be resolvable through a font collection - and the font is deliberately NOT installed (see PROVENANCE.md).
